tables.title: Area Under the ROC Curve
notes: DeLong standard errors and confidence intervals. The z test compares the AUC with 0.5.

tables.title: Optimal Cut-off (Youden Index)
notes: The cut-off is the midpoint between two neighbouring observed values. It is optimistic when applied to the same sample.

tables.title: Comparison of AUCs (DeLong)
notes: Paired test: both markers were measured on the same subjects.

assumptions.message: Both outcome groups have at least 30 subjects.

interpretation.text: s100b discriminated Poor from Good with an AUC of 0.731, 95% CI [0.630, 0.833], which is acceptable discrimination. The optimal cut-off of 0.205 gave a sensitivity of 63.4% and a specificity of 80.6%. The AUCs of s100b and ndka did not differ significantly, z = 1.39, p = .164.

title: ROC Curve Analysis
code:
library(ggnext)
# ROC analysis of s100b, ndka for outcome
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("outcome", "s100b", "ndka"), drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
d$outcome <- droplevels(factor(d$outcome))
markers <- c("s100b", "ndka")
outcome_levels <- levels(d$outcome)   # negative, positive
roc_list <- lapply(markers, function(m) pROC::roc(d$outcome, d[[m]], levels = outcome_levels, direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE))
names(roc_list) <- markers
auc_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(markers, function(m) {
  r <- roc_list[[m]]
  ci <- pROC::ci.auc(r, conf.level = 0.95, method = "delong")
  se <- sqrt(pROC::var(r, method = "delong"))
  data.frame(marker = m, auc = ci[2], se = se, lower = ci[1], upper = ci[3], z = (ci[2] - 0.5) / se,
             p = 2 * pnorm(abs(ci[2] - 0.5) / se, lower.tail = FALSE), direction = r$direction)
}))
# Cut-off that maximises the Youden index (sensitivity + specificity - 1)
best <- do.call(rbind, lapply(markers, function(m) {
  b <- pROC::coords(roc_list[[m]], "best", best.method = "youden", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"))[1, ]
  data.frame(marker = m, b, youden = b$sensitivity + b$specificity - 1)
}))
# DeLong test for each pair of correlated ROC curves
pairs <- t(combn(markers, 2))
comparison <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  rt <- pROC::roc.test(roc_list[[pairs[i, 1]]], roc_list[[pairs[i, 2]]], method = "delong", paired = TRUE)
  data.frame(marker1 = pairs[i, 1], marker2 = pairs[i, 2], difference = unname(rt$estimate[1] - rt$estimate[2]), z = unname(rt$statistic), p = rt$p.value)
}))
# Long format; markers where lower values indicate a positive outcome are reversed
roc_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(markers, function(m) data.frame(marker = m, truth = as.integer(
d$outcome == outcome_levels[2]),
  score = if (roc_list[[m]]$direction == ">") -d[[m]] else d[[m]])))
p <- ggnext(roc_long, aes(truth = truth, score = score, color = marker)) +
  geom_roc() +
  labs(title = "ROC curves", x = "1 − Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
  theme_modern()
